newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Inter-Pacific closes US$10 mln revolver.
newsitem.headline: Inter-Pacific closes US$10 mln revolver.

text.p: PT Inter-Pacific Bank's US$10 million revolving credit facility has been completed, arranger Sanwa Bank Singapore said on Monday.
The facility has a final maturity of three years.
It pays 145 basis points over the Singapore Interbank Offered Rate (SIBOR) to tax-absorbing lenders and 100 basis points over SIBOR to standby letter of credit lenders.
There is a tax-absorption fee of 45 basis points.
With fees, the all-in return for tax-absorbing lenders at the top level is 160 basis points, while standby letter of credit lenders will receive 115 basis points.
Lenders are Sanwa Bank Singapore, Bank of Nova Scotia Singapore, Banque Francaise du Commerce Exterieur Singapore, Hua Nan Commercial Bank Singapore and Ta Chong Bank Taiwan.
